intro: Camping 101: Leatherworking directs fledgling leatherworkers to seek advanced instruction on crafting durable wilderness shelters. Guided to Indari Sunseam in Shen'dar Village, craftsmen learn to stitch protective tents that offer essential rest across long expeditions into the wilds.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've become a leatherworker. Good for you, adventurer. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to make yourself a tent that will keep you cool on hot days, and dry on rainy days.
With a good tent over your head, you'll ensure that you get all the rest you need to stay sharp on your travels.

clips.title: Completion
paras: There you have it, your very own camp tent. Most folk don't care much for tents being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
